Default Title - R 950.00 ZAR Quantity Add to Cart   Caline's CP-46 Fuzzy Bear is a vintage germanium fuzz like the classic Arbiter Fuzz Face or Hartman with its smooth vintage fuzz. All the classic sound at a much lower price! It features more of a Vintage sound than Caline's other pedals but has the highest quality components of anything they've done so far. The Level and Fuzz controls allow a surprising amount of control from subtle to all out attack. Don't forget to use your guitar volume knob and pickup selector for further control. A smooth, vintage fuzz sound. Uses vintage germanium transistor. Full metal shell. True bypass. Features: Input: 1/4” monaural jack (impedance: 10k Ohms) Output: 1/4” monaural jack (impedance: 1k Ohms) True Bypass design, with aluminum alloy casing Power Requirements: AC adapter 9V DC Center Negative Current consumption: 50mA Product Dimensions: 11.2x6.4x3.4cm Weight:0.23kg POWER SUPPLY NOT INCLUDED Share Share on Facebook Tweet on Twitter Pin on Pinterest Customer Reviews Based on 2 reviews Write a review 100% (2) 0% (0) 0% (0) 0% (0) 0% (0) C Customer Great seller, really excellent, good product Apologies for only reviewing now. Between my day job and building a home studio I had little time to play. The fuzz is great. It stacks well with overdrives such as the Leon and the Caline Blue Sky. Not sure one needs to go for big brands when this quality is available at such a nice price. Like other reviewers noted, understand that this pedal has to be dialed in near full volume and gain. The seller is extremely serious about customer service. I have ordered twice now and on both occasions I had a tracking number within less than 24 hours. M Mervyn Cool pedal, but CRANK the level I initially thought the pedal was faulty, as it made some really unpleasant, tinny noises with the knobs on 12 o’clock. Fortunately I did some research before returning; turns out you have to gun the level switch full-tilt to get a good sound; and oh my word, what a good sound it is! After figuring out this one really odd thing about this pedal, I absolutely adore it. Really nice warm, dirty fuzz sounds. I was super impressed with the fast shipping - overnight.
